in_sanskrit.name: कामु
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Kamu in Sanskrit is derived from the root word 'kama' which means desire, passion, or love. In Hinduism, Kamadeva is the god of love and desire, and the name Kamu could be seen as a reference to this deity.

in_hindi.name: कामु
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Kamu in Hindi is derived from the same Sanskrit root word 'kama'. It holds the same meaning as in Sanskrit, and is used to denote the concept of desire, passion, or love.

in_tamil.name: காமு
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Kamu in Tamil is also derived from the same Sanskrit root word 'kama'. It holds the same meaning as in Sanskrit and Hindi, and is used to denote the concept of desire, passion, or love.

in_telugu.name: కాము
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Kamu in Telugu is also derived from the same Sanskrit root word 'kama'. It holds the same meaning as in Sanskrit, Hindi, and Tamil, and is used to denote the concept of desire, passion, or love.

in_marathi.name: Kamu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of desire, beauty
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kamu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Kamu is the name of the goddess of desire, beauty, and sexuality. She is also known as Rati, the wife of the god of love, Kamadeva. In Hindu mythology, Kamu is depicted as a beautiful woman with a red body, four arms, and adorned with precious gems and flowers.
